shortDescription: Slow-cooked chipotle barbacoa with crispy roasted potato wedges
subtitle: Slow-cooked chipotle barbacoa with crispy roasted potato wedges
description: Slow-cooked shredded barbacoa chicken piled beside crispy roasted potato wedges — chipotle, lime, and cumin braise until pull-apart tender while wedges roast golden in the oven.

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Crock Barbacoa Chicken With Potato Wedges in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on. Use limes as listed — measure each before heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch chicken. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Roast potato wedges
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss potato wedges with olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper on two sheet pans in a single layer. Roast 28–35 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp at the edges.

steps.title: Layer crock ingredients
steps.instruction: Place onion slices in bottom of 8-quart slow cooker. Arrange chicken thighs on top in an even layer without stacking too deep. Plan about 5 minutes for this step at crew scale. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early. Target 165°F at the thickest point before moving to the next batch.

steps.title: Mix braising liquid
steps.instruction: Whisk chipotle, adobo sauce, lime juice, vinegar, cumin, oregano, garlic, salt, pepper, and broth until smooth. Keep finished cold items below 41°F if they sit more than 30 minutes — nest the hotel pan on ice at the line. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Slow cook until tender
steps.instruction: Pour liquid over chicken. Cover and cook on low 6–8 hours until meat pulls apart easily and internal temp reaches 165°F throughout.

steps.title: Shred in pot
steps.instruction: Transfer thighs to a cutting board if easier, or shred in crock with two forks. Meat should separate into moist strands, not dry clumps.

steps.title: Reduce juices if needed
steps.instruction: If liquid is thin, simmer shredded chicken on high 20–30 minutes uncovered until sauce clings to meat with a glossy coat. Maintain a steady simmer — bubbles should break the surface without a rolling boil that shreds delicate proteins. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early. Target 165°F at the thickest point before moving to the next batch.

steps.title: Verify safe internal temps
steps.instruction: Spot-check the thickest pieces with an instant-read thermometer — target 165°F. If any piece reads low, return it to heat immediately rather than holding under temp on the line.

steps.title: Platter for the line
steps.instruction: Pile shredded barbacoa on a large crew platter beside the roasted potato wedges. Garnish with lime wedges and cilantro. Keep rice and bowls off this spread — wedges are the carb.

proTips: Thighs beat breast here—long cook needs fat for tender shred.
Roast wedges on parchment for easier cleanup after a long shift.
Freeze shredded portions in cooking liquid for fast taco nights — re-crisp fresh wedges when you serve.
tonightSpread: Lime wedges and fresh cilantro on the platter.
Simple shredded lettuce if crews want greens.
leftovers: Barbacoa breakfast burritos with eggs and salsa.
Re-crisp leftover wedges in a hot oven 8 minutes.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Set-and-forget protein with a hearty wedge side that holds hot on the line. Smoky heat without standing over a smoker all day.
mealPrepNotes: Start crock on low by mid-morning. Roast potato wedges on sheet pans while chicken finishes. Shred with two forks directly in the pot to save dishes. Station: Do not lift lid during first 3 hours—each peek adds 15 minutes cook time. Station: Skim fat before shredding for cleaner flavor and easier cleanup. Station: Hold shredded chicken in juice at 165°F—dry holding ruins barbacoa texture. Station: Crisp wedges on a hot sheet pan 5 minutes before service if they softened during hold.
